verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents load balancing across multiple LLM models/providers, which implies routing resilience, but the evidence never explicitly describes an automatic fallback mechanism triggered by provider failure (e.g., retry-on-error, circuit breaking, or failover behavior). Missing for 10: explicit fallback-on-failure documentation, failure detection/health-check mechanism, and any hands-on confirmation that fallback actually occurs when a provider errors out.
